photo.alt: The Paramaribo waterfront with its UNESCO-listed buildings

facts: About 252,600 people (2025 estimate), almost half the country
On the banks of the Suriname River
worth_knowing: Named for the Paramaribo people at the river's mouth, from Tupi-Guarani words for "large river" and "inhabitants". Its historic inner city has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2002.
